body:
I saved the cloth with white crystals for you. The seed trial crew passed Monday morning; my eyes began burning, and afterward the county van arrived.

I carried it home because there was nowhere open to return it. The mark did not come off when I tried to wash my hands.

When I returned, the window was closed and the board was blank. I kept the page because it was the only one with our address.
title: Handwritten letter

body:
I made a hat to keep the rain off the radio. It looked ridiculous, so nobody noticed when I carried it from room to room.

The same street names came through three times. After the second reading a visitor told us the broadcast had never happened and asked for the radio.

I took the battery out first. The station may be silent now, but I want to know what it says if it comes back.
title: Diary entry
